summary: Ethan's first dinner at the parents' house: he is stiffly formal (합니다), Seoyun teases him, mother keeps refilling his bowl, and over fruit it is settled that he is coming to 서현's wedding next month as family.

paragraphs.ko: 토요일 저녁, 이선은 서윤이와 같이 서윤이 부모님 댁에 갔다. 집 앞에서 이선은 조금 긴장했다.
paragraphs.en: Saturday evening, Ethan went with Seoyun to her parents' house. In front of the house, he was a little nervous.

paragraphs.ko: 서윤: "엄마, 우리 왔어요." 어머니: "이선 씨, 왔어요? 들어와요, 들어와요. 여기 앉아요."
paragraphs.en: Seoyun: "Mom, we're here." Mother: "Ethan, you made it? Come in, come in. Sit here."
Ethan: "Thank you so much for inviting me tonight."

paragraphs.ko: 서윤이 작은 목소리로 말했다. "왜 그렇게 말해? 여기 우리 집이야. 회사 아니야." 이선도 작게 말했다. "처음이잖아. 나 지금 너무 긴장했어."
paragraphs.en: Seoyun said in a small voice, "Why are you talking like that? This is our house, not an office." Ethan whispered back, "It's my first time. I'm really nervous right now."

paragraphs.ko: 식탁 위에 맛있는 반찬이 정말 많았다. 어머니는 이선에게 계속 고기를 줬다.
paragraphs.en: There were so many delicious side dishes on the table. Mother kept giving Ethan more meat.

paragraphs.ko: 어머니: "많이 먹어요. 이것도 먹어 봐요. 내가 만든 거예요." 이선: "네, 잘 먹겠습니다. 정말 맛있습니다."
paragraphs.en: Mother: "Eat a lot. Try this too. I made it." Ethan: "Yes, thank you for the food. It's really delicious."

paragraphs.ko: 아버지가 웃으면서 말했다. "이선 씨, 한국 음식 잘 먹네요. 나도 처음 이 사람 집에 갔을 때 많이 긴장했어요." 어머니: "아니에요. 이 사람은 밥만 먹었어요."
paragraphs.en: Father smiled and said, "Ethan, you eat Korean food well. I was very nervous too the first time I went to her family's house." Mother: "Oh, please. He just ate."

paragraphs.ko: 어머니가 또 고기를 줬다. "더 먹어요, 더." 서윤: "엄마, 이선 씨 밥 두 그릇 먹었어요."
paragraphs.en: Mother gave him more meat again. "Eat more, more." Seoyun: "Mom, Ethan has had two bowls of rice."

paragraphs.ko: 식사 후에 다 같이 과일을 먹었다. 그때 어머니가 이선에게 말했다. "곧 서현이 결혼식이 있어요. 이선 씨도 같이 가죠?"
paragraphs.en: After dinner, everyone ate fruit together. Then Mother said to Ethan, "Seohyun's wedding is coming up soon. You're coming with us, right?"

paragraphs.ko: 이선: "네? 저도 가도 됩니까?" 어머니: "같이 가야죠. 이선 씨도 이제 우리 가족이에요."
paragraphs.en: Ethan: "Pardon? I can come too?" Mother: "Of course you're coming. You're part of our family now."

paragraphs.ko: 아버지가 이선을 보고 말했다. "결혼식에서는 그렇게 긴장하지 마요." 모두 웃었다. 이선도 웃었다. "네, 꼭 가겠습니다."
paragraphs.en: Father looked at Ethan and said, "Don't be that nervous at the wedding." Everyone laughed. Ethan laughed too. "Yes, I'll definitely be there."

paragraphs.ko: 집에 돌아오는 차 안에서 서윤이가 이선을 보고 웃었다. "거 봐. 엄마가 너 이제 가족이래." 이선: "정말? 너무 긴장해서 무슨 맛인지도 몰랐어."
paragraphs.en: In the car on the way home, Seoyun looked at Ethan and laughed. "See? Mom says you're family now." Ethan: "Really? I was so nervous I couldn't even tell what anything tasted like."

questions.prompt_en: Why did Seoyun tell Ethan "this isn't an office"?
How many bowls of rice did Ethan eat?
